resources.string: One future inbox for RCS, MMS, SMS and private DATA. This early native build only opens your existing messaging app to compose a text.
SMS · delegated to device messaging app
This does not send or store a message in GoreeCloud. Review and tap Send in your chosen messaging app. The other app chooses whether it uses SMS, MMS or another service.
